instruments.notes: Fixed price swap entered December 1998; covers approx 65% of daily production; fair value at 12/31/1998 approx $(292,000); 10% price change changes fair value by approx $79,000 per month. Direction not explicit in text.
instruments.evidence_quote:
During December 1998, the Company
entered into a fixed price swap for $1.96 per MMbtu. This fixed price swap
covers 13,000 MMbtu per day, or approximately 65% of daily production

instruments.notes: Several natural gas collars in place during 1997 and 1998 covering 5,000-20,000 MMbtu per day (30%-60% of daily production); floor and cap prices not disclosed; no active collars at 12/31/1998; net settlement gains approx $33,000 (1997) and $482,000 (1998). Expired, historical.
instruments.evidence_quote:
During 1997 and 1998 the Company had in place several natural gas
commodity collars with a financial institution covering 5,000 - 20,000 MMbtus
per day, or approximately 30%--60% of the Company's daily production.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Enters hedging transactions (collars and swaps) on a portion of natural gas production to mitigate price exposure and achieve more predictable cash flow; not for trading or speculative purposes.
